title_parts.text: scroll coupon row into view and highlight

content_blocks.markdown:
**Arguments**
```json
{
  "args": [],
  "function": "() => {
  const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="row"], .ag-row, tr')).find(r => r.innerText.includes('节省 5% 4A Sticky Notes Essentials'));
  if (row) {
    row.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });
    row.style.outline = '3px solid #00a86b';
    return { found: true, text: row.innerText };
  }
  return { found: false };
}",
  "pageId": 20,
  "waitForStableDom": false
}
```
